sentences.en: On a rainy Tuesday morning, I head to the Bronx Montefiore Medical Center,
sentences.zh: 在一个下雨的周二早晨，我前往纽约的大型教学医院——

sentences.en: a large teaching hospital in New York.
sentences.zh: 布朗克斯蒙蒂菲奥里医疗中心。

sentences.en: Up on the orthopedics floor, I find a waiting room dense with people.
sentences.zh: 在骨科楼层，我看到一个挤满人的候诊室。

sentences.en: The scene feels familiar.
sentences.zh: 这场景似曾相识。

sentences.en: A harried receptionist, some snoozing patients,
sentences.zh: 一个忙碌的接待员、几个打瞌睡的病人，

sentences.en: and a TV playing a home remodeling show.
sentences.zh: 以及一台播放着家居装修节目的电视。

sentences.en: Martin Levy walks up to greet me and my producer.
sentences.zh: 马丁·利维走过来迎接我和我的制片人。

sentences.en: Hi, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你好吗？

sentences.en: Come on, let's get you comfortable.
sentences.zh: 来吧，先让你坐舒服点。

sentences.en: In his day job, Martin's an orthopedic surgeon here at Montefiore.
sentences.zh: 在日常工作中，马丁是蒙蒂菲奥里医院的一名骨科医生。

sentences.en: He's been fixing broken athletes for more than 40 years.
sentences.zh: 他修理受伤的运动员已经超过40年了。

sentences.en: anterior cruciate ligament reconstructions,
sentences.zh: 前十字韧带重建、

sentences.en: meniscal surgery, whether it be repair or resection.
sentences.zh: 半月板手术，无论是修补还是切除。

sentences.en: He leads me down the hallway to a little workshop,
sentences.zh: 他领着我穿过走廊来到一个小作坊，

sentences.en: like something Santa might have.
sentences.zh: 就像圣诞老人的工坊一样。

sentences.en: We're walking into the skills laboratory.
sentences.zh: 我们正走进技能实验室。

sentences.en: It's crammed with orange Home Depot buckets,
sentences.zh: 里面塞满了橙色的家得宝水桶、

sentences.en: saws, drills, wood, rope.
sentences.zh: 锯子、电钻、木头和绳子。

sentences.en: Here we have two types of drills, one a smaller one.
sentences.zh: 这里有两种电钻，一种较小。

sentences.en: Martin tells me orthopedic surgery is built on pretty basic carpentry.
sentences.zh: 马丁告诉我，骨科手术建立在非常基础的木工活之上。

sentences.en: One of his jobs is to teach incoming residents these skills.
sentences.zh: 他的工作之一就是向新来的住院医师传授这些技能。

sentences.en: So we need to teach them to tie a variety of knots.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要教他们打各种结。

sentences.en: They need to be able to drill a hole.
sentences.zh: 他们需要能够钻孔。

sentences.en: They need to be able to put a screw in.
sentences.zh: 他们需要能够把螺丝拧进去。

sentences.en: They need to be able to use devices known as reamers,
sentences.zh: 他们需要能够使用被称为铰刀的器械，

sentences.en: where they cut holes or they gouge large sockets.
sentences.zh: 用它们来钻孔或扩挖大型窝槽。

sentences.en: For Martin, the bar is high.
sentences.zh: 对马丁来说，标准很高。

sentences.en: He needs to teach skills.
sentences.zh: 他需要传授技能。

sentences.en: He also needs his students to perform those skills
sentences.zh: 他还要求他的学生在压力巨大且干扰众多的

sentences.en: in an environment where there's huge pressure and many distractions.
sentences.zh: 环境中展现这些技能。

sentences.en: When they go into an operating room,
sentences.zh: 当他们进入手术室时，

sentences.en: surgeons need to have their technique down to muscle memory.
sentences.zh: 外科医生的技术必须达到肌肉记忆的程度。

sentences.en: Martin uses the analogy of a baseball play.
sentences.zh: 马丁用棒球比赛来打比方。

sentences.en: The suicide squeeze in baseball is one of my favorite plays.
sentences.zh: 棒球中的自杀挤垒是我最喜欢的战术之一。

sentences.en: It starts with a man at third base trying to score.
sentences.zh: 它始于三垒有人试图得分。

sentences.en: The batter, at this point, attempts to bunt the ball, put it in play,
sentences.zh: 此时击球手试图用触击把球打进场内，

sentences.en: while the runner at third base is running home.
sentences.zh: 同时三垒的跑垒员向本垒冲刺。

sentences.en: When you look at the field, there's all of these activities going on.
sentences.zh: 当你看着球场时，所有这些活动都在同时发生。

sentences.en: The third baseman is crashing, the first baseman is crashing,
sentences.zh: 三垒手在冲防，一垒手在冲防，

sentences.en: The pitcher is trying to throw the ball at the batter
sentences.zh: 投手试图把球投向击球手

sentences.en: so he can't bunt the ball effectively.
sentences.zh: 让他无法有效地触击。

sentences.en: And on top of it, there's a runner that's running right at the bunter.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，还有一个跑垒员正朝着触击手直冲过来。

sentences.en: So in order for us to execute a bunt effectively
sentences.zh: 因此，为了在情绪高度紧绷、环境如此复杂的情况下

sentences.en: in a highly charged environment, with all of this going on,
sentences.zh: 有效地完成触击战术，

sentences.en: we need to practice bunting.
sentences.zh: 我们需要练习短打。

sentences.en: Martin wants his students to know how to use their tools
sentences.zh: 马丁希望他的学生知道如何使用他们的工具

sentences.en: in the same way a great baseball player knows how to bunt.
sentences.zh: 就像伟大的棒球运动员知道如何短打一样。

sentences.en: So he designed a lab where students could practice to perfection.
sentences.zh: 因此他设计了一个实验室，让学生们可以在那里练习到完美。

sentences.en: The goal of the skill lab is to take tools and to teach each individual tool until it can be used fluently.
sentences.zh: 技能实验室的目标是掌握各种工具，并教授每一种工具，直到能够流利使用。

sentences.en: The baseball bat.
sentences.zh: 棒球棒。

sentences.en: Any pitch can be bunted into the field.
sentences.zh: 任何投球都可以被短打击入场内。

sentences.en: The drill.
sentences.zh: 钻头。

sentences.en: In any position, with any drill bit, on any material, with any shape.
sentences.zh: 在任何位置、使用任何钻头、在任何材料上、用任何形状。

sentences.en: a drill hole can be made.
sentences.zh: 都可以打出一个钻孔。

sentences.en: Martin had some challenges in designing his lab.
sentences.zh: 马丁在设计实验室时遇到了一些挑战。

sentences.en: Cost was one.
sentences.zh: 成本就是其中之一。

sentences.en: Practicing on medical-grade materials like cadavers and plastic bones
sentences.zh: 在尸体和塑料骨骼等医用级材料上练习

sentences.en: just didn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 根本说不通。

sentences.en: They're expensive.
sentences.zh: 它们太贵了。

sentences.en: And cadavers, they're in limited supply.
sentences.zh: 而且尸体的供应也很有限。

sentences.en: Instead, he came up with cheap substitutes
sentences.zh: 相反，他想出了便宜的替代品

sentences.en: like PVC pipe, twine, and two-by-fours.
sentences.zh: 比如PVC管、麻绳和两乘四英寸的木方。

sentences.en: Martin even came up with some interesting replacements
sentences.zh: 马丁甚至想出了一些有趣的替代品

sentences.en: for the human body.
sentences.zh: 来代替人体。

sentences.en: One of my favorite models is the cast on an eggplant.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的模型之一是套着石膏的茄子。

sentences.en: They put an actual cast, like you'd have on a broken arm, on an eggplant,
sentences.zh: 他们在茄子上缠上真正的石膏，就像你骨折时打的那种石膏一样，

sentences.en: and then they ask residents to saw off the cast without cutting the eggplant.
sentences.zh: 然后他们要求住院医师在不切破茄子的前提下把石膏锯掉。

sentences.en: An eggplant is very similar to fragile skin.
sentences.zh: 茄子非常类似于脆弱的皮肤。

sentences.en: So the cast on there gives the resident the opportunity to really test their skill
sentences.zh: 所以上面的石膏让住院医师有机会真正考验他们的技能

sentences.en: without hurting anybody, but if the eggplant is leaking, then you need to keep practicing.
sentences.zh: 而不会伤害任何人，但如果茄子漏汁了，你就得继续练习。

sentences.en: So picture the lab.
sentences.zh: 所以想象一下这个实验室。

sentences.en: It's quiet, full of inexpensive materials, and there's no pressure.
sentences.zh: 这里很安静，摆满了便宜的材料，而且没有任何压力。

sentences.en: Students can practice for as long as they need.
sentences.zh: 学生们可以根据需要练习多久就练习多久。

sentences.en: And of course, Martin has another cheap and simple teaching tool, the clicker.
sentences.zh: 当然，马丁还有另一个便宜又简单的教学工具——响片。

sentences.en: So good morning, Zach.
sentences.zh: 早上好，扎克。

sentences.en: So what we're going to do today is...
sentences.zh: 我们今天要做的就是……

sentences.en: On this day, Martin's with one of his students, Zachary Sharfman.
sentences.zh: 在这一天，马丁和他的一个学生扎卡里·沙夫曼在一起。

sentences.en: I'm a PGY-1, which means post-grad year one.
sentences.zh: 我是PGY-1，也就是毕业后第一年住院医师。

sentences.en: That's your first year after you've graduated from medical school.
sentences.zh: 那是你从医学院毕业后的第一年。

sentences.en: Zach is here to practice one particular knot,
sentences.zh: 扎克来这里练习一个特定的结，

sentences.en: one that Martin says is crucial in orthopedic surgery.
sentences.zh: 马丁说这个结在骨科手术中至关重要。

sentences.en: A slider knot is useful in shoulder surgery
sentences.zh: 滑结在肩部手术中很有用

sentences.en: because it allows us to be able to fix soft tissue to bone.
sentences.zh: 因为它允许我们将软组织固定到骨头上。

sentences.en: If you can imagine, there's an anchor at the end of this,
sentences.zh: 你可以想象，这端有一个锚钉，

sentences.en: and then what we'd be able to do is be able to push soft tissue down to the bone and tie it.
sentences.zh: 然后我们要做的就是把软组织推到骨头上并把它系紧。

sentences.en: First, Martin shows Zach how to tie the knot.
sentences.zh: 首先，马丁向扎克展示如何打这个结。

sentences.en: All right, first, this is what it looks like.
sentences.zh: 好的，首先，它是这样的。

sentences.en: He demonstrates on a length of rope.
sentences.zh: 他在一段绳子上做示范。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: And that's a completed knot.
sentences.zh: 这就是打好的结。

sentences.en: So let's go build that.
sentences.zh: 我们开始做吧。

sentences.en: Each time Zach performs a step correctly, Martin acknowledges it with a click.
sentences.zh: 每当扎克正确地完成一个步骤，马丁就会用按响响片来表示认可。

sentences.en: The first step of this is to place one-third of the rope directly over two-thirds of the rope.
sentences.zh: 第一步是把三分之一的绳子直接搭在三分之二的绳子上面。

sentences.en: The tag point is over.
sentences.zh: 标记点到位。

sentences.en: We're going to do it five times, and each time that you hit the tag point,
sentences.zh: 我们要重复五次，每一次你到达标记点，

sentences.en: I'm going to mark it with the marker.
sentences.zh: 我就会用马克笔做个记号。

sentences.en: And if you would say it as you're doing it, one-third over two-thirds.
sentences.zh: 请你边做边说出来，三分之一搭在三分之二上。

sentences.en: One-third, over two-thirds.
sentences.zh: 三分之一，搭在三分之二上。

sentences.en: And if you do it again, please.
sentences.zh: 请再做一次。

sentences.en: After five successful clicks, they begin the next step,
sentences.zh: 在成功获得五次响片反馈后，他们开始下一步，

sentences.en: and then the next, until they reach the final step.
sentences.zh: 接着是下一步，直到达到最后一步。

sentences.en: One-third, over two-thirds, over and through,
sentences.zh: 三分之一，搭在三分之二上，绕过并穿过，

sentences.en: fakie pinch, backside grab, address the knot, deliver.
sentences.zh: 假捏，反手抓，对准结，推送。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Throughout the lesson, there's a complete absence of emotional language.
sentences.zh: 在整个教学过程中，完全没有任何情感化的语言。

sentences.en: No, great job, or well done,
sentences.zh: 没有“太棒了”或“干得好”，

sentences.en: Or no, wrong.
sentences.zh: 也没有“不对，错了”。

sentences.en: What are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你在干什么？

sentences.en: There's none of that.
sentences.zh: 完全没有这些。

sentences.en: The only feedback is the sound of the clicker.
sentences.zh: 唯一的反馈就是响片的声音。

sentences.en: The only reward for the student is the mastery of the skill, not the approval of the teacher.
sentences.zh: 学生唯一的奖励是对技能的掌握，而不是老师的赞许。

sentences.en: This is why I use the clicker.
sentences.zh: 这就是我使用响片的原因。

sentences.en: It is baggage-free.
sentences.zh: 它是没有包袱的。

sentences.en: It is emotional-free.
sentences.zh: 它是没有情感负担的。

sentences.en: Zach Sharfman has worked with Martin on a variety of nods.
sentences.zh: 扎卡里·沙夫曼曾与马丁合作过各种结法。

sentences.en: He says when he's got one down perfectly, his fingers just know what to do.
sentences.zh: 他说，当他把某个结练得炉火纯青时，他的手指自然就知道该怎么做了。

sentences.en: I think a nice way to put it is, if you put your fingers ready to snap, and I challenge you to do that and get them ready, it's hard to not snap.
sentences.zh: 我想一个很好的比喻是，如果你把手指摆好准备打响指，我让你这么做并做好准备，你很难忍住不打响指。

sentences.en: And what I think we're really developing here is a way to say, the rope's in your hand, it's loaded, you're ready to snap, it just comes naturally.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们在这里真正培养的是这样一种状态：绳子在你的手里，已经蓄势待发，你准备好打响指了，一切都是那么自然。

sentences.en: Martin Levy's clicker training techniques make him an outlier in medicine, but clicker training is becoming a fixture in a variety of fields.
sentences.zh: 马丁·利维的响片训练技术使他成为医学界的一个特例，但响片训练正在成为各个领域的一项常态。

sentences.en: It's being used to help people become better dancers, fishermen, and golfers.
sentences.zh: 它正被用于帮助人们成为更好的舞者、渔民和高尔夫球手。

sentences.en: So you get to the top of your backswing, hear the click,
sentences.zh: 所以你到了上杆的顶点，听到响片声，

sentences.en: and then once you hear the click,
sentences.zh: 一旦你听到响片声，

sentences.en: you're then going to obviously go with your downswing sequence.
sentences.zh: 很显然，你接下来就要开始你的下杆动作了。

sentences.en: You want to hear that click again at the impact zone when you hit the ball.
sentences.zh: 当你击球时，你希望在击球区再次听到那个响片声。

sentences.en: Martin uses a variety of teaching tools.
sentences.zh: 马丁使用了各种各样的教学工具。

sentences.en: The clicker is just one of them.
sentences.zh: 响片只是其中之一。

sentences.en: But the lesson it imparts is crucial.
sentences.zh: 但它传授的课程至关重要。

sentences.en: We start with a clicker to teach people how to be language-free and to mark very precisely.
sentences.zh: 我们从响片开始，教导人们如何做到无语言化并进行非常精确的标记。

sentences.en: We transition them over a very short period of time to other methodologies.
sentences.zh: 在很短的时间内，我们将他们过渡到其他方法。

sentences.en: For instance, you can't hear a clicker when a saw is on.
sentences.zh: 例如，电锯开动时你是听不见响片声的。

sentences.en: So we use flashlights.
sentences.zh: 所以我们使用手电筒。

sentences.en: We transition to using a very benign good.
sentences.zh: 我们过渡到使用一个非常温和的“好”字。

sentences.en: It is just a mark.
sentences.zh: 它只是一个标记。

sentences.en: you have hit the target precisely.
sentences.zh: 你已经精准地命中了目标。

sentences.en: One of the interesting stories to tell you is that you have two learners.
sentences.zh: 要讲的一个有趣的故事是，你有两个学习者。

sentences.en: The first learner is exceptional,
sentences.zh: 第一个学习者非常优秀，

sentences.en: and they get through exactly what you're teaching in a very short period of time.
sentences.zh: 他们在很短的时间内就完全掌握了你所教的内容。

sentences.en: And you say, good, great job.
sentences.zh: 然后你会说，很好，干得漂亮。

sentences.en: The next learner has difficulty,
sentences.zh: 下一个学习者遇到了困难，

sentences.en: and you work with them for three or four, ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 你和他们一起练习了三四分钟，甚至十分钟。

sentences.en: And you're sitting there, and they finally get it.
sentences.zh: 你坐在那里，他们终于学会了。

sentences.en: You go, way to go.
sentences.zh: 你会说，真棒。

sentences.en: That's terrific.
sentences.zh: 太厉害了。

sentences.en: And the first learner is sitting there going, what?
sentences.zh: 而第一个学习者坐在那里想，什么？

sentences.en: I don't get this.
sentences.zh: 我不明白。

sentences.en: He struggled.
sentences.zh: 他遇到了困难。

sentences.en: He gets all the accolades.
sentences.zh: 他获得了所有的赞誉。

sentences.en: And I, I got a good.
sentences.zh: 而我，我只得到一个“好”。

sentences.en: Well, if everybody gets good, then we don't have the baggage that that brings.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果每个人都得到“好”，那么我们就没有了由此带来的包袱。

sentences.en: What was, you must have heard reactions from some people, some residents, some parents of residents sort of saying, this is ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 你一定听到过一些人的反应，一些住院医师、住院医师的家长们会说，这太荒谬了。

sentences.en: How can you teach our kids the way you're teaching dogs?
sentences.zh: 你怎么能像教狗一样教我们的孩子？

sentences.en: I haven't had anybody taken back.
sentences.zh: 我没有遇到任何人感到被冒犯。

sentences.en: Everybody has worked with us.
sentences.zh: 每个人都与我们合作过。

sentences.en: I think the only comment I've ever heard is, my girlfriend trains her dog this way.
sentences.zh: 我想我听过的唯一评论是，我女朋友就是用这种方式训狗的。

sentences.en: And I said, yes, and I bet you it was really effective.
sentences.zh: 我说，是的，我敢打赌这非常有效。

sentences.en: And he said, yeah, it was great.
sentences.zh: 他说，对，太棒了。

sentences.en: We tell them before we start, this is operant learning.
sentences.zh: 我们在开始前告诉他们，这是操作性条件反射学习。

sentences.en: Here's the concepts behind it.
sentences.zh: 以下是其背后的概念。

sentences.en: And hang in there.
sentences.zh: 坚持下去。

sentences.en: It's going to work.
sentences.zh: 它会起作用的。

sentences.en: There's a radical idea at the heart of clicker training.
sentences.zh: 响片训练的核心是一个激进的理念。

sentences.en: It suggests that teaching can be effective without the use of criticism,
sentences.zh: 它表明教学在不使用批判的情况下可以是有效的，

sentences.en: but also without the use of praise.
sentences.zh: 同时也不需要使用表扬。

sentences.en: Now, you might think that this makes teachers unimportant.
sentences.zh: 现在，你可能会认为这使得老师变得不重要了。

sentences.en: You'd be completely wrong.
sentences.zh: 那你就大错特错了。

sentences.en: The teacher is anything but a bystander.
sentences.zh: 老师绝不是旁观者。

sentences.en: That's because it's the teacher who designs the world in which the student learns.
sentences.zh: 这是因为正是老师设计了学生学习的世界。

sentences.en: To put this another way, the challenge in teaching pigeons
sentences.zh: 换句话说，教鸽子的挑战

sentences.en: doesn't actually lie in teaching pigeons.
sentences.zh: 实际上并不在于教鸽子本身。

sentences.en: The challenge lies in building a box in which the pigeons can learn.
sentences.zh: 挑战在于建造一个能让鸽子学习的箱子。

sentences.en: How to design learning so it becomes natural, commonplace, even predictable?
sentences.zh: 如何设计学习，使其变得自然、寻常甚至可预测？

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续关注我们。

sentences.en: Everyone can think of learning moments when things broke down.
sentences.zh: 每个人都能想到学习受挫的时刻。

sentences.en: One reason for this is that experts often make poor teachers.
sentences.zh: 原因之一是专家往往不是好老师。

sentences.en: Once you've mastered a skill, it becomes difficult to remember what it felt like to not know the skill.
sentences.zh: 一旦你掌握了一项技能，就很难再想起不懂这门技能时的感觉。

sentences.en: Once you know how to ride a bike, you might say to a newbie,
sentences.zh: 一旦你学会了骑自行车，你可能会对新手说，

sentences.en: just push off, start pedaling.
sentences.zh: 直接往前蹬，开始踩脚踏板就行了。

sentences.en: It takes an enormous act of effort, of empathy,
sentences.zh: 这需要付出巨大的努力和同理心，

sentences.en: to go back and remember how it felt when something seemed confusing or impossible.
sentences.zh: 才能回过头去记起当某事显得困惑或不可能时是什么感觉。

sentences.en: This is sometimes called the curse of expertise.
sentences.zh: 这有时被称为专家的诅咒。

sentences.en: Experts forget how difficult it can be to learn something
sentences.zh: 专家们忘记了学习某样东西会有多难

sentences.en: because they've already mastered it.
sentences.zh: 因为他们已经完全掌握了它。

sentences.en: I was coaching basketball for little kids.
sentences.zh: 我曾在教小孩子们打篮球。

sentences.en: Again, orthopedic resident Zach Sharfman.
sentences.zh: 再次说明，这是骨科住院医师扎卡里·沙夫曼。

sentences.en: This time, he's playing the role of teacher rather than student.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他扮演的是老师而非学生的角色。

sentences.en: And I stepped up to a free throw line.
sentences.zh: 我走到罚球线前。

sentences.en: I dribbled the ball.
sentences.zh: 我运了运球。

sentences.en: I spun it the way that I'm used to spinning it.
sentences.zh: 我按照我习惯的方式旋转着球。

sentences.en: I put my feet in the right position.
sentences.zh: 我把双脚放在正确的位置。

sentences.en: I squared my hips and shoulders to the basket.
sentences.zh: 我的臀部和肩膀正对篮筐。

sentences.en: I tucked my elbow in.
sentences.zh: 我把手肘收好。

sentences.en: I shot the ball.
sentences.zh: 我把球投了出去。

sentences.en: My hand arced and finished in the right position.
sentences.zh: 我的手划出弧线并在正确的位置完成了动作。

sentences.en: I handed it to the kid, and I said, go ahead, do the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我把球递给那个孩子，然后我说，去吧，照着做一遍。

sentences.en: Zach, as you can probably tell, is a very good basketball player.
sentences.zh: 扎克如你所见，是个非常优秀的篮球运动员。

sentences.en: So good that he forgets how many little skills he's internalized in order to make the shot.
sentences.zh: 优秀到他甚至忘了自己内化了多少小技巧才能把球投进。

sentences.en: The kid he was teaching didn't get it.
sentences.zh: 他正在教的那个孩子却没弄懂。

sentences.en: His feet are lined up wrong, and his shoulders are lined up wrong,
sentences.zh: 他的双脚站位不对，双肩的对齐方向也不对，

sentences.en: and his elbow's out to the side, and the ball's sitting not square on his shooting hand,
sentences.zh: 而且他的手肘向外撇，球也没有端端正正地放在投篮手上，

sentences.en: but it's sitting in between his two hands.
sentences.zh: 而是夹在两只手之间。

sentences.en: And I look at him and I go, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 我看着他问：你在干什么？

sentences.en: It's not at all what I did.
sentences.zh: 这跟我做的完全不一样。

sentences.en: And it was completely unreasonable as a teacher for me to expect him to be able to shoot the ball that way.
sentences.zh: 作为一个老师，我指望他能用那种方式把球投进，是完全不合理的。

sentences.en: And I think what mattered was then slowing down and going step by step and saying,
sentences.zh: 我想，关键在于慢下来，一步一步地说：

sentences.en: OK, this is where your feet are.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是你脚放的位置。

sentences.en: Now, every time you get to this line, your feet start here.
sentences.zh: 听着，每次你来到这条线时，双脚都要从这里开始。

sentences.en: Don't think about catching the ball.
sentences.zh: 不要去想接球的事。

sentences.en: Don't grab the ball.
sentences.zh: 不要去抓球。

sentences.en: Don't worry about shooting.
sentences.zh: 不要担心投篮。

sentences.en: Start with your feet here.
sentences.zh: 先把脚放在这里。

sentences.en: In other words, to be effective, Zach had to tease apart a complex procedure.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，为了达到效果，扎克必须把一个复杂的流程剖析开来。

sentences.en: He had to break his technique down into teachable parts.
sentences.zh: 他必须把自己的技术拆解成可教的步骤。

sentences.en: This is what Martin Levy calls task analysis,
sentences.zh: 这就是马丁·莱维所说的任务分析，

sentences.en: and it lies at the very heart of what you have to do to make clicker training work.
sentences.zh: 这也是让响片训练发挥作用的核心所在。

sentences.en: It requires the teacher to possess not just expertise,
sentences.zh: 它不仅要求老师具备专业知识，

sentences.en: but the patience to deconstruct what they know into bite-sized pieces,
sentences.zh: 还要有耐心把所知拆解成易消化的碎片，

sentences.en: to break down skills into their components and subcomponents,
sentences.zh: 把技能拆解成各个组成部分和子部分，

sentences.en: and to keep doing this until every single student can master them.
sentences.zh: 并不断重复，直到每个学生都能掌握它们。

sentences.en: Martin says one of the great masters of task analysis was the Royals and White Sox baseball coach, Charlie Lau.
sentences.zh: 马丁说，任务分析的大师之一就是皇家队和白袜队的棒球教练查理·劳。

sentences.en: Even the great hitters in professional baseball need help.
sentences.zh: 即使是职业棒球里伟大的击球手也需要帮助。

sentences.en: Welcome to the Art of Hitting 300 with Charlie Lau.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到查理·劳的《击球三部曲》。

sentences.en: And what he did is he took a number of the greatest baseball players, greatest hitters of all time,
sentences.zh: 他所做的是挑选了一些伟大的棒球运动员、有史以来最伟大的击球手，

sentences.en: and he looked at their swings and what he was able to find, but there are common points, there are commonalities in these swings.
sentences.zh: 观察他们的挥棒，并从中发现这些挥棒有着共同的点、共同的规律。

sentences.en: And when you took all the commonalities out, you could build this cookie cutter where you could take someone who wasn't a natural and you could say,
sentences.zh: 当你把所有的共性都提炼出来，你就能打造出一个模具，这样就算面对没有天赋的人，你也可以说：

sentences.en: follow these steps and at least we'll get you close.
sentences.zh: 按照这些步骤来，至少我们能让你接近成功。

sentences.en: This is what Martin Levy wants to do, build a series of systematic steps to teach the skills he wants his students to learn.
sentences.zh: 这也是马丁·莱维想要做的：建立一系列系统的步骤，来教授他希望学生掌握的技能。

sentences.en: Martin needs to do it right.
sentences.zh: 马丁必须把这件事做好。

sentences.en: Medical residents, he says, seem to take criticism especially hard.
sentences.zh: 他说，医学住院医师似乎对批评格外敏感。

sentences.en: These are professionals who are highly motivated,
sentences.zh: 这些专业人员动力十足，

sentences.en: who've done well in school, who want to be successful.
sentences.zh: 在学校表现优异，渴望成功。

sentences.en: So when they're not performing up to expectation,
sentences.zh: 因此，当他们的表现没有达到预期时，

sentences.en: it is unpleasant, they're not happy about it,
sentences.zh: 这会让人很不舒服，他们会感到不高兴，

sentences.en: and it's my job to get them past it.
sentences.zh: 而我的工作就是帮他们跨过这道坎。

sentences.en: One way Martin gets students past it
sentences.zh: 马丁帮学生跨过这道坎的方法之一，

sentences.en: is to communicate that the responsibility for learning
sentences.zh: 就是让他们明白学习的责任

sentences.en: is really on him, the teacher.
sentences.zh: 其实在于他自己，也就是老师。

sentences.en: The student has to show up, be motivated.
sentences.zh: 学生必须到场，并且充满动力。

sentences.en: But if a student doesn't get something, that means Martin has done something wrong.
sentences.zh: 但如果学生没学会什么，那就意味着马丁有哪里做错了。

sentences.en: The skill he's trying to teach has not been broken down sufficiently.
sentences.zh: 他试图教授的技能还没有被充分拆解。

sentences.en: The steps have not been rehearsed systematically.
sentences.zh: 步骤还没有经过系统化的排练。

sentences.en: The fault lies not with the student, but with the teacher.
sentences.zh: 过错不在学生，而在老师。

sentences.en: So let's say we're tying a knot, and there's six steps to tying the knot.
sentences.zh: 比方说我们在打结，打这个结一共有六个步骤。

sentences.en: And in the fourth step, the knot is breaking down.
sentences.zh: 到了第四步，结开始打不成了。

sentences.en: We're just, it's not happening.
sentences.zh: 我们就是、就是搞不定。

sentences.en: Well, it's on the teacher at that point to say, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这时候老师就得说，行吧。

sentences.en: It may mean that we take a part that we always have done as one step, and now it turns into two steps, or three.
sentences.zh: 这可能意味着我们要把一个原本当作一个步骤的动作，现在拆成两个或三个步骤。

sentences.en: But now the learner is successful.
sentences.zh: 但现在学习者成功了。

sentences.en: This is not the way learning unfolds in many parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 这并不是学习在世界许多地方展开的方式。

sentences.en: Students are often blamed for their failure to learn.
sentences.zh: 学生学不会往往会被怪罪。

sentences.en: Sorry, sister.
sentences.zh: 对不起，修女。

sentences.en: Now get yourself into the corner and put on the dunce's hat.
sentences.zh: 现在去角落里戴上傻瓜帽吧。

sentences.en: Martin Levy has come to understand that the teacher-student relationship is complicated.
sentences.zh: 马丁·莱维逐渐明白，师生关系是复杂的。

sentences.en: it.
sentences.zh: 它。

sentences.en: One person has power, one does not.
sentences.zh: 一个人有权力，一个人没有。

sentences.en: One person has expertise, one does not.
sentences.zh: 一个人有专业知识，一个人没有。

sentences.en: One person can offer
sentences.zh: 一个人可以给予

sentences.en: praise, the other is hungry for validation.
sentences.zh: 赞扬，而另一个人渴望得到肯定。

sentences.en: This relationship can be destroyed in a single
sentences.zh: 这种关系可能在短短的

sentences.en: unthinking moment.
sentences.zh: 一个不经意的瞬间就被毁掉。

sentences.en: Martin remembers a time this happened, not with a resident, but with his dog
sentences.zh: 马丁记得有一次发生了这样的事，不是跟住院医师，而是跟他的狗

sentences.en: Penny.
sentences.zh: 佩妮。

sentences.en: We were working on a series of jumps.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在练习一系列的跳跃。

sentences.en: It's referred to as a serpentine.
sentences.zh: 这被称为蛇形绕杆。

sentences.en: It's three jumps that
sentences.zh: 这是三个跳跃，

sentences.en: or parallel to each other.
sentences.zh: 它们彼此平行。

sentences.en: And we kept knocking the middle bar down.
sentences.zh: 我们一直把中间的栏杆撞掉。

sentences.en: And at the time, I just picked up the bar,
sentences.zh: 当时，我只是捡起栏杆，

sentences.en: tapped the ground, and went, damn.
sentences.zh: 敲了敲地，说了句：该死。

sentences.en: And my dog ran off into a tunnel and hid.
sentences.zh: 然后我的狗跑进一条隧道里藏了起来。

sentences.en: It took Martin an hour and lots of treats
sentences.zh: 马丁花了一个小时和大量的零食，

sentences.en: to get her to come back out.
sentences.zh: 才把它引出来。

sentences.en: Now, medical residents who see a teacher get frustrated
sentences.zh: 现在，看到老师感到沮丧的医学住院医师

sentences.en: don't run into a tunnel and hide.
sentences.zh: 不会跑进隧道里藏起来。

sentences.en: They don't usually reveal feelings of humiliation or shame.
sentences.zh: 他们通常不会表现出羞辱或羞愧的感觉。

sentences.en: But they are listening and internalizing those reactions.
sentences.zh: 但他们一直在听，并将这些反应内化。

sentences.en: The voices of teachers, and this is something Freud might have said,
sentences.zh: 老师的声音——这或许是弗洛伊德会说的话——

sentences.en: become part of the way students talk to themselves.
sentences.zh: 成了学生对自己说话的方式的一部分。

sentences.en: I think the take-home message for that, for me,
sentences.zh: 我认为对我来说，从这当中得到的启示是，

sentences.en: was how fragile learning moments can be.
sentences.zh: 学习的时刻是多么脆弱。

sentences.en: Where everybody's trying hard, the dog was trying hard to be successful,
sentences.zh: 每个人都在努力，狗狗在努力取得成功，

sentences.en: I was trying hard to be successful,
sentences.zh: 我也在努力取得成功，

sentences.en: but just a simple action of, damn.
sentences.zh: 但仅仅是一个简单的动作：该死。

sentences.en: And the dog interpreted that as her failure
sentences.zh: 狗狗把这解读为它的失败，

sentences.en: and was not able to perform after that for a couple of days.
sentences.zh: 并且在接下来的几天里都无法正常表现。

sentences.en: Martin says the clicker can help to take frustration out of the equation.
sentences.zh: 马丁说，响片可以把沮丧情绪从这个过程中剔除出去。

sentences.en: And this is a very good method of freeing people up,
sentences.zh: 这是一个解放人们的好方法，

sentences.en: opening them up, allowing them to accept new information
sentences.zh: 让他们敞开心扉，能够接受新的信息，

sentences.en: without all of the debris that comes along with it.
sentences.zh: 而没有随之而来的各种精神包袱。

sentences.en: I'm quiet, you're quiet.
sentences.zh: 我很安静，你也很安静。

sentences.en: We're just learning a skill.
sentences.zh: 我们只是在学习一项技能。

sentences.en: But I think what I'm hearing you say is that
sentences.zh: 但我想我听到你的意思是，

sentences.en: there's all of this psychological relationship
sentences.zh: 老师和学生之间存在着所有的心理关系，

sentences.en: between teacher and student,
sentences.zh: 师生之间存在着种种心理关系，

sentences.en: which in some ways is crowding
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，这正在挤占

sentences.en: the actual engagement with the material itself.
sentences.zh: 对材料本身的实际投入。

sentences.en: What does my teacher think of me?
sentences.zh: 我的老师是怎么看我的？

sentences.en: Does my teacher like me?
sentences.zh: 我的老师喜欢我吗？

sentences.en: Does my teacher hate me?
sentences.zh: 我的老师讨厌我吗？

sentences.en: Does my teacher approve of me?
sentences.zh: 我的老师对我满意吗？

sentences.en: Does my teacher disapprove of me?
sentences.zh: 我的老师对我不满意吗？

sentences.en: Am I doing it right?
sentences.zh: 我做对了吗？

sentences.en: Am I doing it better with my friend?
sentences.zh: 我和朋友比起来做的好吗？

sentences.en: Am I faster than my friend?
sentences.zh: 我比我朋友动作快吗？

sentences.en: Can I show the teacher I'm actually a really good student?
sentences.zh: 我能向老师证明我其实是个好学生吗？

sentences.en: Can I show the teacher I'm the best student that the teacher has ever had?

sentences.zh: 卡特·舒克克内希特和卢希克·瓦巴。

sentences.en: our unsung heroes this week
sentences.zh: 我们本周的无名英雄

sentences.en: are the members of NPR's training team
sentences.zh: 是 NPR 培训团队的成员

sentences.en: they recently put together
sentences.zh: 他们最近组织了

sentences.en: a three day training palooza
sentences.zh: 一场为期三天的培训狂欢

sentences.en: members of our team
sentences.zh: 我们团队的成员

sentences.en: took part in sessions on everything
sentences.zh: 参加了涵盖各方面内容的课程

sentences.en: from interviewing techniques
sentences.zh: 从采访技巧

sentences.en: to design thinking
sentences.zh: 到设计思维

sentences.en: a big thank you to the training team
sentences.zh: 非常感谢培训团队

sentences.en: for organizing an event
sentences.zh: 组织了这样一场活动

sentences.en: that allowed us to learn new things
sentences.zh: 让我们能够学习新知识

sentences.en: and to think about the work
sentences.zh: 并以全新的方式思考

sentences.en: we're already doing in new ways
sentences.zh: 我们已经在做的工作

sentences.en: one last thing before we go
sentences.zh: 在我们离开前的最后一件事

sentences.en: we're working on an episode
sentences.zh: 我们正在制作一期节目

sentences.en: about something that many people think about
sentences.zh: 关于许多人会想到

sentences.en: but rarely discuss with others.
sentences.zh: 但很少与他人讨论的事情。

sentences.en: Revenge.
sentences.zh: 复仇。

sentences.en: Have you ever been wronged in a way
sentences.zh: 你是否曾受到过某种伤害

sentences.en: that made you seek revenge against the wrongdoer?
sentences.zh: 让你想要向作恶者寻求复仇？

sentences.en: Maybe a partner who cheated on you,
sentences.zh: 也许是一个背叛你的伴侣，

sentences.en: a friend who betrayed your trust,
sentences.zh: 一个辜负你信任的朋友，

sentences.en: a mentor or financial advisor who led you astray.
sentences.zh: 一个把你引入歧途的导师或财务顾问。

sentences.en: If you tried to avenge yourself
sentences.zh: 如果你曾试图复仇

sentences.en: and would be interested in sharing your story
sentences.zh: 并且有兴趣在接下来的节目中

sentences.en: in an upcoming episode,
sentences.zh: 分享你的故事，

sentences.en: please record your story on your phone
sentences.zh: 请用手机录下你的故事

sentences.en: and email it to us at hiddenbrain at npr.org.
sentences.zh: 并将其发送电子邮件至 hiddenbrain@npr.org。

sentences.en: Include your full name and phone number
sentences.zh: 请附上你的全名和电话号码

sentences.en: and use the subject line,
sentences.zh: 并在主题栏中填写，

sentences.en: Revenge.
sentences.zh: 复仇。

sentences.en: Again, that's hiddenbrain at npr.org.
sentences.zh: 再说一遍，邮箱是 hiddenbrain@npr.org。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham,
sentences.zh: 我是香卡·维丹塔姆，

sentences.zh: 这是 NPR。
